title: audit-report template variables
description: Values for templates/audit-report.md.j2 and templates/audit-report.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from audit-report.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

date.title: Date
date.description: The date the scan ran, ISO. Drift is measured from this date and the rubric is versioned by year, so an undated report cannot be compared to the next one.

extracted_rules.title: Extracted rules
extracted_rules.description: Which rule ids were promoted into constitution.md this pass. If none were, write none - an audit that extracts nothing every time is a report nobody is acting on.

next_scan_due.title: Next scan due
next_scan_due.description: Date the next drift scan is due, ISO - 90 days out unless you have a reason. Unscheduled audits become annual, and annual audits are archaeology.

snapshot_version.title: Snapshot version
snapshot_version.description: What the scan actually read - the tag, commit SHA or lockfile hash. Without it a PASS cannot be tied to the code that passed, and the next failure looks like a regression.
